name: conflux-devkit
description: Conflux Development Kit - Professional monorepo for blockchain development

scripts.clean:all: pnpm clean:cache && pnpm clean:builds && pnpm clean:modules
scripts.clean:cache: rm -rf .turbo packages/*/.turbo ~/.cache/turbo 2>/dev/null; rm -rf node_modules/.cache node_modules/.vite packages/*/node_modules/.cache packages/*/node_modules/.vite 2>/dev/null; echo 'Cache cleaned'
scripts.clean:modules: rm -rf packages/*/node_modules pnpm-lock.yaml 2>/dev/null; rm -rf node_modules 2>/dev/null || echo 'Note: root node_modules may be in use - close IDE/processes and retry'; echo 'Modules cleaned'
scripts.clean:builds: rm -rf packages/*/dist packages/*/.next packages/*/.nuxt packages/*/build packages/*/*.tsbuildinfo 2>/dev/null; echo 'Builds cleaned'
scripts.reset: pnpm clean:all && pnpm install && pnpm build

author: Conflux DevKit Team
